title: Hotpatch Triage and Risk Register — Sprint Bridge
content:
Meeting: Hotpatch Triage / Sprint Bridge
Date: 2025-02-12 09:30 PST
Facilitator: Alex Chen
Attendees: Priya Kaur, Miguel Santos, Janelle Ortiz, Samir Patel, Lena Volkova, Paul Rees (SRE join-in)

Agenda:
- Quick health check on current release train (v2025.02)
- Review open hotfixes and severity / SLA impact
- Risk register updates (new items + mitigations)
- Changelog items to include in release note draft
- Action items and owners for follow-up

Notes / Highlights:
1) Release train status
- v2025.02 is green for majority of microservices. Canary run (canary-3) showed elevated tail latency on embedder service between 02:10–02:22 UTC (seen in trace RLSD-4213).
- Canary traffic diverted to fallback GPU pool at 02:24; no customer-facing errors reported. Need deeper root cause analysis for KV cache eviction pattern that coincides with noisy neighbor behavior on dedicated nodes.
- Decision: keep canary paused for next 24h until KV cache tuning landed (PR #1987).

2) Hotfixes in flight
- HF-014 (priority P1) — Immediate rollback of quantization change in model-serving v1.3.2.
  - Trigger: degraded generation quality for long prompts reported by CS (ticket OPS-342).
  - Owner: Priya Kaur leading rollback + regression checklist.
  - Status: rollback deployed to dedicated pool (region us-west1) at 03:05. Monitoring shows metrics returning to baseline. Post-rollback canary scheduled for 02/13 01:00 UTC.
- HF-015 (priority P2) — Observability agent crash on upgrade; SRE patched agent image.
  - Owner: Samir. Monitoring agent stable but a small drop in trace coverage (approx 6% loss). Plan to re-instrument in the next maintenance window.

3) Risk register (new / updated)
- Risk R-2025-03: Increased tail-latency from KV cache thrashing on dedicated pools during mixed workloads.
  - Impact: potential SLO breaches for latency-sensitive customers.
  - Likelihood: medium (observed 2x in last week).
  - Mitigation: immediate kernel-level cache tuning (PR #1992) + adjust routing policy to favor isolated pools for high-priority traffic. Owner: Miguel Santos.
  - Contingency: fallback to CPU decode variant for affected requests.
- Risk R-2025-04: Regressions from model quantization pipeline changes (seen in HF-014).
  - Impact: generation quality regressions affecting customer outputs.
  - Mitigation: add automated prompt-set regressions to the CI gating for quantization changes; require mandatory eval pass for each quant profile. Owner: Janelle Ortiz.

4) Changelog candidates (for v2025.02 release notes)
- FEATURE: Controlled rollout of config-based KV cache sizing per model class (experimental). (See RFC: confluence ref in linked artifacts)
- FIX: Rollback quantization tweak that caused long-prompt quality regressions (HF-014).
- OPS: Observability agent stability improvements and reduced memory leak in trace exporter.
- NOTE: Canary traffic paused while KV cache tuning is verified.

5) Blockers / open questions
- Who signs off on re-enabling canary after PR #1992 lands? Proposal: SRE + release-engineering co-sign. Action: Alex to coordinate sign-off window.
- We still lack a reliable metric for "prompt-length-weighted quality" in CI; current scalar evals miss degradation for edge-case long prompts. Janelle to prototype a weighted eval set.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- A1: Finish KV cache tuning PR (#1992) and deploy to canary pool. Owner: Miguel Santos. Due: 2025-02-13 EOD.
- A2: Merge rollback postmortem into release playbook (short paragraph + links to HF-014 timeline). Owner: Priya Kaur. Due: 2025-02-14.
- A3: Add targeted long-prompt evals to quantization CI gating; draft test vectors. Owner: Janelle Ortiz. Due: 2025-02-18.
- A4: Re-instrument observability agent and restore full trace coverage; coordinate with SRE. Owner: Samir Patel. Due: 2025-02-20.
- A5: Prepare consolidated changelog for comms + CS (short bullets + impact note). Owner: Alex Chen. Due: 2025-02-13 12:00 PST.

Misc notes / quick wins:
- Temporary routing rule added to prefer dedicated-isolated pools for "high_priority" tag; requires final cleanup after canary is stable. (Task: infra cleanup ticket: INFRA-765)
- Suggestion: Add a one-page checklist to weekly release call: "hotfix triage quick rubric" — short do/don'ts for rollback vs patch. (Volunteer: Lena)

Next meeting: 2025-02-14 09:30 PST (follow-up bridge to confirm canary status and close actions A1/A5).

Appendix: quick links referenced during the call:
- HF-014 rollback timeline: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HF-014
- PR landing for observability agent: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1987
- KV cache tuning draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=82341234

Notes to self (Alex):
- Make sure release-notes draft is in the shared "release-notes" folder before notifying comms.
- Follow up with CS on customer cases that triggered OPS-342, ask for anonymized prompt examples for Janelle's evals.

Status: working draft; will update after A1 result and canary re-run.
